name: Light Brown Hair Color Shampoo – Quick & Easy Gray Coverage, 200ml Natural-Looking Dye

Transform your hair color in just minutes with this fast-acting Light Brown Hair Color Shampoo. Specially formulated for quick and convenient application, this 5-minute color shampoo delivers natural-looking brown tones while effectively covering gray hairs — all without the mess of traditional hair dyes.
Enriched with herbal extracts and conditioning agents, the formula nourishes the hair while coloring, leaving it soft, shiny, and vibrant. Ideal for both men and women, this hair dye shampoo is perfect for those seeking a quick, at-home solution to refresh their look without visiting a salon.

Convenient 200 ml bottle for home use or travel
